name: Steam Store and Web API (keyless endpoints)
summary: Keyless Steam endpoints: store appdetails, live player counts and per-game news for any appid, including Counter-Strike 2.
description: A subset of the Steam platform APIs that answer without a key: store.steampowered.com/api/appdetails returns price, genres, requirements, screenshots and Metacritic data for an appid; ISteamUserStats/GetNumberOfCurrentPlayers returns the live concurrent players; ISteamNews/GetNewsForApp returns recent announcements. User-level and inventory endpoints need a free Steam Web API key and are not covered here.

auth.notes: The three endpoints listed work without a key; a free key (Steam account required) is needed for most other Web API interfaces.

rate_limit.summary: API terms cap Web API use at 100,000 calls per day per key; the store appdetails endpoint is undocumented and is known to throttle after bursts (not re-confirmed).

endpoints.summary: Current concurrent players for an appid
Latest news items for an appid
Store page data for an appid (price, genres, requirements, screenshots)

license.name: Steam Web API Terms of Use (Valve); game data belongs to publishers

agent_notes: Query appdetails with one appid per call: a two-appid request with filters=price_overview returned empty data arrays today. Use cc= for currency and l= for language. 730 is Counter-Strike 2, 570 is Dota 2. Success is signalled by "success": true inside the body even on HTTP 200.
caveats: No CORS header on api.steampowered.com or the store endpoint; call it from a server.
store.steampowered.com/api/appdetails is not part of the official documentation, so its shape can change.
ISteamApps/GetAppList/v2 returned 404 today; the app list now needs the IStoreService interface with a key (not tested).

verification.notes: Player-count example executed without a key; appdetails and GetNewsForApp also answered 200 without a key.
